$$S(m,54) = 55\int_0^1 (1-s)^{54-m}\,ds = \frac{55}{55-m}.$$

**Correct computation:** The other steps check out. There are 4 aces, 4 kings, 4 queens, and 50, 46, and 42 cards in the relevant complements. Since $N$ is the maximum of the first-appearance positions of the three ranks, inclusion-exclusion gives

$$E[N] = 3S(50,54) - 3S(46,54) + S(42,54).$$

- $S(46,54) = \frac{55}{9}$

So

$$E[N] = 33 - \frac{55}{3} + \frac{55}{13} = \frac{1287 - 715 + 165}{39} = \frac{737}{39} \approx 18.90.$$
